subtasks.title: Explore and localize
subtasks.prompt: Use admissible navigation, opening, looking, and examination commands to find the exact numbered target and destination.
subtasks.success_criterion: The next required target object or receptacle is localized.

subtasks.title: Acquire and transform
subtasks.prompt: Acquire the target and perform any required cleaning, heating, cooling, slicing, or lighting action.
subtasks.success_criterion: The held object has the state required by the task.

subtasks.title: Place and verify
subtasks.prompt: Move the exact numbered object to the required receptacle and check environment completion.
